title: Enhancing Door-Status Detection for Autonomous Mobile Robots during Environment-Specific Operational Use
summary: A door-presence and open/closed-status detector adapted to environment-specific mobile-robot operation.

mechanisms.name: Door presence and status qualification
mechanisms.description: Separates door detection from open/closed state because the state changes the topological connectivity available to a robot.
mechanisms.limitations: Environment-specific fine-tuning and robot-camera evaluation do not establish cross-building generalization, passage clearance, or safe human guidance.
